technical_summary: VS Code extension vendor building inline AI suggestions and streaming completion. Primary constraints: sub-50ms interactive latency target, per-user rate limits for public extension, SAML/SCIM for enterprise onboarding, ability to pin model versions per release channel, and cost controls via quantization and batching. Wants SDK examples for streaming and a recommended token-exchange pattern for secure in-editor calls.
poC_details: Prototype uses background service to hold API key for dev org. Extension opens SSE to background service which proxies to Redwood hosted API with streaming. Measured median token latency ~45ms in US-west testing; 95th ~70ms. Next: run dedicated instance (Dedicated or Private) to compare latency and do SAML flow. Need Redwood sample for per-user token issuance + short-lived tokens.
commercial_notes: Prefers usage-based hosted plan for beta, evaluating Dedicated for v1 enterprise customers. Pricing sensitivity for high-usage customers (code completions generate heavy token counts). Interested in reserved capacity for predictable cost and latency guarantees.
sales_playbook_notes: Position Redwood Optimize to recommend batching and quant profiles; propose pilot with reserved burst capacity and a scoping call with solutions engineering. Offer to run a 2-week dedicated latency test with a small pool of GPUS to validate <50ms 95th.
